title: Meng Tian, Qin general
summary: Meng Tian was a general of the First Emperor of Qin who campaigned against the Xiongnu in the Ordos region and oversaw building of a frontier wall linking older walls. After the emperor died in 210 BCE, a forged order sent him to prison, where he took poison.

uncertainty.note: Birth is not given. The range runs from about 221 BCE (the northern campaign, probably, per Keay) to his forced death soon after the First Emperor died in 210 BCE; Keay does not give the exact year of Meng Tian's death. The Ordos campaign is dated 221 BCE by Keay and 215 or 214 BCE by other accounts.

where.historical_name: Hetao, northern frontier of the Qin empire

importance.justification: The Qin general credited with the northern campaign and the frontier wall.
